overall.basis: No overall (or any exterior) dimension is printed on any plan picture, so width/depth are null. Front = the garage-door gable end (bottom of the plan): the source captions the renders showing it 'Front Elevation', and the published Width 22' / Depth 46' put the narrow end at the front; the entrance door itself is on the RIGHT side. Published page facts: Width 22' = 6.706 m, Depth 46' = 14.021 m, Height 17'1" = 5.207 m (height used here is published only). Cross-check only (TRACED, not a printed value): scaling plan 16 by the garage label 21/0 x 22/6 (interior, ~100.4 px/m, bedroom 10/8 and living 10/0 widths agree) gives an enclosed rectangle of about 6.73 x 14.06 m including the enclosed garage; canopy, patio and stoops excluded.

uncertain: No printed overall dimensions: widthM/depthM and polygonM are null. The ~6.73 x 14.06 m rectangle is TRACED from room labels and must not be read as printed; published 22' x 46' is a separate page fact.
No orthographic elevations: all facade evidence is perspective renders (3-6, 12, 13, 14) cross-checked against wall openings in plan 16.
Twin windows (bedroom and living on the rear, living under the canopy) are drawn in plan as two sashes separated by a narrow mullion stub; each pair is counted as one window.
RIGHT side order (front to rear): garage window, garage service door, entry door, twin living window. Garage window looks squarer in render 6 and narrower in render 13.

LIVING/DINING label 10/0 X 20/0: the drawn space from rear wall to the garage partition traces ~6.7 m (22'), so the 20'-0" apparently excludes the kitchen counter strip along the partition (or is nominal).
Patio slab drawn in plan as ~0.91 x 3.21 m (TRACED) under the canopy; the renders show a larger slab extending toward the rear.
Garage door width not labelled; traces ~5.5 m.
Front choice: captions call the front-right renders 'Front Elevation' without saying which face is front; garage gable end taken as front (plan orientation, published width 22').
Roof pitch and ridge height not determinable; height 5.207 m published only.
confidence: MEDIUM-LOW - clear plan and consistent renders of all four sides, but no printed exterior dimension and no orthographic elevation; size known only from the published facts and traced room labels.
